verdict.rationale: Skyfire's documented protocol covers agent identity and payment tokens (kya, pay, kya-pay) and their creation/charging/introspection via API and MCP tools (find-sellers, create-kya-token, create-pay-token, create-kya-payment-token), but there is no documented call for creating or updating a cart or order draft — carts/orders would live on the seller's own commerce platform, not in Skyfire's API surface.
